name: EA Surface Water Spatial Planning Depths Climate Change
fact: Updated 6 July 2026; climate-change surface-water depth data provides seven depth bands across 0.1%, 1% and 3.3% AEP scenarios using UKCP18 RCP8.5 upper-end 2070s allowances.
gate: Modelled strategic planning evidence; parcel-level FRA remains required.

name: EA national flood and coastal risk information update
fact: Environment Agency announced new Flood Map for Planning surface-water spatial-planning datasets on 28 May 2026, including future climate scenarios.
gate: Announcement confirms dataset generation, not a parcel flood conclusion.

name: EA Source Protection Zones merged
fact: Updated 20 March 2026; Source Protection Zones screen risks around large/public potable groundwater abstractions using modelled groundwater travel time.
gate: SPZ membership is a groundwater-protection screen, not a development prohibition by itself.

name: EA Source Protection Zones Defra platform
fact: EA's current data-service page provides SPZ downloads and WMS/WFS/OGC services; revision date 6 March 2026.
gate: Exact parcel intersection plus current groundwater policy assessment required.

name: EA Drinking Water Safeguard Zones Groundwater
fact: Updated 7 April 2026; groundwater safeguard zones identify areas around public supplies where additional pollution-control measures are needed.
gate: Safeguard-zone membership requires proposal-specific pollution-risk assessment.

name: EA Drinking Water Safeguard Zones Defra platform
fact: EA platform provides groundwater safeguard-zone data based largely on SPZ2 plus additional pollution assessment.
gate: Use exact geometry and current action-plan/regulatory requirements for the parcel.

name: Groundwater vulnerability data for England
fact: Updated 16 July 2026; the BGS/EA dataset maps groundwater vulnerability to pollutants discharged at ground level and supersedes older EA vulnerability data.
gate: Vulnerability is a screening input; development impact depends on exact activity and hydrogeology.

name: Aquifer Designation Dataset for England version 2
fact: Updated 16 July 2026; classifies bedrock/superficial units as Principal, Secondary A/B/undifferentiated or Unproductive Strata.
gate: Aquifer class is environmental context, not parcel development permission.

name: BGS GeoIndex Aquifer Vulnerability Maps index
fact: Index updated 16 July 2026, but the underlying 1:100,000 vulnerability maps date from late 1980s/early 1990s and BGS notes newer EA digital data may exist.
gate: Use newer digital groundwater datasets for current parcel screening.

name: Coal Development High Risk Area
fact: Mining Remediation Authority dataset updated 14 April 2026 maps areas with recorded shallow coal-mining features posing potential stability/public-safety risk.
gate: High-risk-area intersection generally triggers Coal Mining Risk Assessment; exact site-specific legacy evidence still required.

name: Planning applications and Coal Mining Risk Assessments
fact: For most development in a Development High Risk Area, a Coal Mining Risk Assessment should identify mine entries, shallow workings, mine gas and other legacy risks and demonstrate a safe/stable strategy.
gate: Exact site risk and competent assessment are required; map membership is not a deterministic refusal.

name: Planning advice service for developing on the coalfield
fact: Updated 25 June 2026; Mining Remediation Authority offers planning advice for proposals within Development High Risk Areas.
gate: Advice service availability is procedural and does not itself establish site safety.

name: Detailed MRA pre-application planning advice
fact: Current guidance says early advice can reduce delay but remains limited to coal-mining legacy and may change as information or policy changes.
gate: Developer remains responsible for demonstrating safe and stable development.

name: Planning guidance hazardous substances
fact: Official guidance explains hazardous-substances consent, controlled quantities and land-use planning around hazardous establishments; page revision is older than current 2026 datasets.
gate: Current legislation, controlled quantities and exact establishment/site context must be checked.

name: HSE hazardous substance consent
fact: HSE states hazardous substance consent is legally required when specified substances are stored/used at or above defined limits, with application made to the hazardous substances authority.
gate: Consent requirement depends on substance, quantity and site; it is separate from planning permission.

name: HSE hazardous consent smart-form FAQ
fact: HSE smart-form guidance supports new consent, condition variation and continuation after change of control and warns incomplete information can delay decisions.
gate: Procedural tool does not establish whether a particular site requires or holds consent.

name: Planning Data local green space dataset
fact: Planning Data currently reports zero local-green-space records, zero providers and no collection attempt; origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Zero platform records must not be interpreted as absence of a local green-space designation.

name: Planning Data built-up area dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 7,157 built-up areas; collector ran 21 July 2026 and source attribution includes ONS/OS while platform provenance notes some MHCLG-created data.
gate: Built-up-area membership is statistical context, not planning allocation or permission.

name: Derby built-up area entity
fact: ONS-authoritative Derby built-up-area entity E63009183 provides exact geometry and point metadata.
gate: Statistical geography cannot be promoted as a planning policy or capacity signal by itself.

name: Planning Data Central Activities Zone dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 10 Central Activities Zone records from three providers; collector ran 22 July 2026 and new data was found 9 June 2026.
gate: Use current GLA/borough plan geography and policy before parcel assignment.

name: Central Activities Zone entity CAZ00000004
fact: CAZ00000004 provides multipolygon geometry and Central London policy context but quality is recorded as 'some'.
gate: Cross-check current GLA/borough CAZ boundary before exact use.

name: Central Activities Zone entity CAZ00000010
fact: CAZ00000010 provides detailed Central London polygon geometry but quality is recorded as 'some'.
gate: Cross-check current GLA/borough boundary and relevant policy before use.

name: Planning Data smoke control area consideration
fact: Planning Data's smoke-control consideration remains at research stage and records restrictive/unclear licence issues for underlying UK Air mapping.
gate: Research-stage consideration is not production parcel geometry.

name: Planning Data smoke control area screen
fact: Screen research identifies UK Air/Defra as the national source and notes smoke-control areas inform plan-making, but publication/licensing constraints remain unresolved.
gate: Do not derive parcel status from design-stage material or restricted map derivatives.

name: High Weald AONB entity
fact: High Weald AONB/National Landscape entity provides mapped geometry and point metadata; entity quality is recorded as 'some'.
gate: Confirm exact Natural England boundary/current protected-landscape policy before parcel scoring.
